name: Non-USD currency conversion of unit/net/total/subtotal
what_it_tests: A non-USD line applies its ISO-specific multiplier across net total/subtotal/total/unit (EUR 0.9346, GBP 0.7874, CAD 1.3889, AUD 1.5385, CHF 0.8850, ILS 3.6251, JPY 149.2537, NZD 1.6667, ARS 666.6667); reads currency-specific PBE
proc_mechanism: Currency Conversion - Net Total / Subtotal / Net Unit Price / Total Line Amount / Unit Price Display (nested IF on STICurrencyIsoCode); currency-matched PricebookEntry; CURRENCYRATE() CMDT
expected_behavior: All currency outputs scaled by the per-ISO multiplier; order/invoice/Workday GL in that currency
test_setup: STICurrencyIsoCode='EUR' (and one line per other ISO), Software, Qty=2; European customer Fortra International GmbH list 100k EUR

NetUnitPrice=NetTotalPrice=TotalLineAmount=TotalPrice=1471.995 ALL CORRECT (= 1575 × 0.9346^1). ListPrice=2943.99 correct (EUR PBE). Base_Price__c=Source_List_Price__c=Pre_Partner_Price__c=1575 (correct USD base preserved). UnitPrice is WRONG and compounds by ×0.9346 on EVERY reprice: measured 1201.66569974 (×0.9346^4), then 1123.07676298 (×0.9346^5) on a later read, then a single controlled Force-reprice (isSuccess=true) drove it to 1049.62754268 = 1575 × 0.9346^6 (exactly prior × 0.9346). The executor had recorded 1285.75401213 (×0.9346^3); my fresh measurements continued the monotonic descent, proving the runaway is live and per-reprice. UnitPrice diverges further from the correct 1471.995 on every pass.

run3_result.defectStep: CurrencyConversionUnitPriceDisplay (V21 step array-index 38, sequenceNumber 40; label 'Currency Conversion - Unit Price Display'): formula InputUnitPrice * IF(STICurrencyIsoCode='EUR',0.9346,...) with output=InputUnitPrice (mapped to persisted UnitPrice). It reads InputUnitPrice carried in from the PRIOR run's persisted UnitPrice (no step re-seeds InputUnitPrice from base for a plain Perpetual line — the only InputUnitPrice writers, AttributeValuePricingCalculatedMode17/index16 under ListContainer6 and GSAPricing36/index51 under ListContainer1, are gated off for this line), then multiplies by the EUR rate AGAIN, compounding ×0.9346 each reprice. By contrast the net steps (CurrencyConversionNetUnitPrice index36 seq39, CurrencyConversionNetTotalSubtotal index35 seq41, CurrencyConversionTotalLineAmount index37 seq42) read NetUnitPrice/ItemNetTotalPrice/TotalLineAmount which ARE rebuilt from scratch each run (ResetNettoPrePartnerBase, the Base_Price__c=1575 bridges), so they land correctly at ×0.9346^1. NOTE: executor mislabeled this as 'seq 36'; seq 36/index36 is actually CurrencyConversionNetUnitPrice (the correct net step). The defective step is the Unit Price Display step at sequenceNumber 40 / array index 38.
